subject: Judge rips ‘callous’ greed of contractor who left cancer-causing asbestos at hospital demo site
posts:
A federal judge has sentenced a suburban contractor to over 6 years for exposing workers to deadly asbestos during a hospital demolition. 🌐

Evidence: Safe remediation, Toxic exposure, Greed over lives
#Aletheia #Environment #Labor

Contractor Carl Fioravanti claimed his firm safely removed cancer-causing asbestos from the Lake Behavioral Hospital site, filing official records to prove compliance and secure his $1.8M payout.

Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

In reality, Fioravanti left massive amounts of asbestos mixed with debris, sending toxic dust airborne. Workers demolished the site without masks, carrying lethal fibers home to their families.
